review_scope: Selective, manually selected prior-art triage of six secondary-CSV works plus one independently located follow-up; not systematic screening, not seven independent studies.

decisions.title: Humanoid Robot Next Best View Planning Under Occlusions Using Body Movement Primitives
decisions.comparator_requirement: Humanoid body-motion-primitives NBV under occlusion; determine reproducibility and source methods before algorithmic reimplementation.
decisions.claims_not_supported: No source-verified matched mission deadline, rough-terrain bipedal contact safety, or inspection-valid accepted coverage.

decisions.title: Humanoid Whole-Body Control for Glass Curtain Wall Inspection Scenarios
decisions.comparator_requirement: Physical whole-body inspection motion control is established; compare task, sensor, terrain and independently validated acquisition endpoint, not generic motion retargeting.
decisions.claims_not_supported: No confirmed rough-terrain walking, blind assessment, or G1 EDU configuration; relation to 2026 journal paper unverified.

decisions.title: VertInspect: Learning-based humanoid whole-body control for glass curtain wall inspection
decisions.comparator_requirement: Contrast motion tracking/trials with independent valid-region documentation, randomised manual comparison and unsupported terrain strata.
decisions.claims_not_supported: Publisher reports three real-world experiments with 15 trials each, not bipedal rough-terrain autonomous inspection or ARC-RVI outcomes; not a verified independent replication of 2025 conference contribution.

decisions.title: FRA-NBV: A Fast and Reflectivity-Aware Next-Best-View Strategy
decisions.comparator_requirement: Represent reflectivity-driven missing-depth recovery by reorienting camera incidence; compare under equal acquisition and motion budget where reflective material is in task scope.
decisions.claims_not_supported: Depth reconstruction coverage is not automatically inspection-valid evidence; published gains are not independent ARC-RVI results.

decisions.title: RASP: Robot Active Scene Perception With Joint Viewpoint Planning and Depth Completion in Cluttered Environments
decisions.comparator_requirement: Account for joint active viewpoint-sequence planning and depth completion, with independent score and common sensing budget. A conceptually matched surrogate is not a claim of source-method replication.
decisions.claims_not_supported: Grasping/point-cloud metrics cannot serve as accepted inspection area without external reference; full model implementation and comparable datasets not reviewed.

decisions.title: CAIS: Culvert Autonomous Inspection Robotic System
decisions.comparator_requirement: Record RGB-D, auxiliary illumination and non-destructive inspection instrumentation as prior end-to-end capabilities; independently score assigned-method coverage, missed required regions, interventions and aborted missions.
decisions.claims_not_supported: No evidence for bipedal G1 EDU rough-terrain autonomy or assessor-blinded manual noninferiority; numerical outcome extraction pending.

decisions.title: A hybrid vision-based surface coverage measurement method for robotic inspection
decisions.comparator_requirement: Define distinct coverage constructs: treated/imaged region vs hidden geometric surface observed vs independently accepted inspection image. Do not use as direct NBV planner baseline.
decisions.claims_not_supported: Shot-peening surface coverage does not prove active unknown-object reconstruction or G1 EDU evidence.
